hero.title: A lantern you can use, repair, maintain, and *pass on*.
hero.intro: Meet the OnePlastic Lantern by OneGrid Energies, a durable, locally assembled rechargeable lantern built from waste plastic bottles, designed to provide dependable light for homes, children studying at night, outdoor activities, emergencies, businesses, and everyday use.

products.statement: We didn't build OnePlastic to be another disposable lantern. We built it to be a lantern you can use, repair, maintain, and pass on. With a strong locally crafted wooden body, a leather handle, recycled-plastic waste components, replaceable internal parts, and a rechargeable lithium-ion battery, OnePlastic brings together durability, practical design, affordability, and sustainability.

story.title: From Waste Plastic to Light
story.question: What if something we throw away could become something that helps us see?
story.text: Every OnePlastic Lantern gives discarded plastic bottles a second life. The waste plastic is transformed into the lantern's distinctive light diffuser, turning a material that could have become environmental waste into part of a product designed for years of use.

image.alt: Close view of the OnePlastic Lantern's clear diffuser, shaped from the base of a recycled plastic bottle, set in the black body with its carry strap

modes.title: Light Your Way, Your Way
modes.intro: OnePlastic gives you control over your lighting experience. Three lighting modes:

items.name: White Light
items.text: Brighter, clearer illumination for reading, working, and everyday tasks.

items.name: Warm + White
items.text: Combines both light sources for maximum brightness.

modes.dimming_text: The lantern also features continuous brightness adjustment. Simply touch and hold the control to adjust the brightness. Release your finger and touch-hold again to change the brightness in the opposite direction.
modes.dimming_note: You can choose the level of light you need instead of being limited to only “on” or “off.”

battery.title: Designed for Long-Lasting Light
battery.intro: OnePlastic uses a 2,000 mAh, 3.7 V lithium-ion battery. Depending on the brightness and lighting mode, it provides approximately:

runtime.label: Warm or white light, full brightness

battery.fade_note: As the battery approaches the end of its available charge, brightness gradually decreases.
battery.note: Actual runtime can vary depending on battery condition, operating temperature, brightness level, and usage.

charging.title: Rechargeable Wherever You Need It
charging.intro: OnePlastic is designed with a 5 V charging input at up to 2 A. You can recharge it using:

options.text: Generator power through a USB charger
Grid electricity through a USB charger

charging.solar_note: A solar panel can also be used to charge the lantern when paired with a suitable charging setup.
charging.indicator: A red charging indicator illuminates when the lantern is connected to a charging source.

repair.title: Built to Be Repaired, Not Thrown Away
repair.lead: This is one of the things that makes OnePlastic different.

paragraphs.text: When many inexpensive lanterns develop a fault, they are simply abandoned, thrown away, or left unused in a corner. We believe products should have a longer life.

OnePlastic is designed so that key components can be replaced rather than forcing you to throw away the entire lantern. If the battery reaches the end of its service life, the battery can be removed from its battery compartment and replaced with a suitable replacement battery.
Other replaceable components are also available through OneGrid Energies, subject to availability.

repair.quote: A fault shouldn't automatically mean the end of the lantern.

image.alt: The OnePlastic Lantern from the side, showing the depth of its black body, the strap fixing and the diffuser

local.title: Made Locally. Designed for Real Problems.

paragraphs.text: OnePlastic is a product born from a simple idea: local problems deserve practical local solutions.

The lantern is locally assembled using materials and craftsmanship available in Nigeria, while selected electronic components are sourced internationally to achieve the required functionality and reliability.

Its wooden body and locally produced packaging and leather handle reflect our commitment to local production and craftsmanship. The diffuser also incorporates recycled plastic waste, giving discarded plastic another useful life.

image.alt: Side view of the OnePlastic Lantern showing its textured leather handle riveted to the black wooden body

tough.title: Built Tough
tough.text: The OnePlastic body is made from solid wood, giving it a distinctive combination of strength, character, and durability. Unlike lightweight disposable lantern housings, the wooden construction gives OnePlastic a substantial and robust feel.
tough.water: The lantern is also designed to be water resistant to IP64, helping protect it against dust and water jets under applicable testing conditions.
tough.note: Please note: IP64 does not mean the lantern is waterproof or designed to be submerged.

keep.title: A Lantern You Can Keep

paragraphs.text: We are not interested in creating products that are used for a short period and then discarded. We want to create products that stay useful. Products that can be repaired. Products whose parts can be replaced. Products that can move from one person to another instead of becoming waste.
That is why we think of OnePlastic as more than a lantern. It is a companion for everyday life.

keep.closing: Buy one. Use it. Maintain it. Repair it. And when the time comes, pass it on.

specs.title: Key Specifications

items.label: Solar charging
items.value: Compatible with suitable external solar charging setup

specs.runtime_note: Runtime varies according to brightness level, battery condition, temperature, and usage.

items.question: How do I charge the OnePlastic Lantern?
items.answer: Through its USB charging input (5 V, up to 2 A), using a USB power adapter, a power bank, generator or grid electricity through a USB charger, or a compatible solar charging system. A red charging indicator lights up when the lantern is connected to a charging source.

items.question: How long does it last on one charge?
items.answer: Approximately up to 13 hours at full brightness using either warm or white light, up to 6 hours at full brightness using warm + white light, and 50+ hours at low-light settings. Actual runtime can vary depending on battery condition, operating temperature, brightness level, and usage.

items.question: Can the battery be replaced?
items.answer: Yes. If the battery reaches the end of its service life, it can be removed from its battery compartment and replaced with a suitable replacement battery. Other replaceable components are also available through OneGrid Energies, subject to availability.

items.question: Is the lantern waterproof?
items.answer: It is designed to be water resistant to IP64, helping protect it against dust and water jets under applicable testing conditions. IP64 does not mean the lantern is waterproof or designed to be submerged.

items.question: Can I charge it with solar power?
items.answer: Yes, with a suitable setup. OnePlastic is compatible with suitable external solar charging setups, and a solar panel can be used to charge the lantern when paired with a suitable charging setup.

items.question: Does it come with a warranty?
items.answer: Yes. The OnePlastic Lantern has a 2-year warranty.

initiative.title: Every purchase supports OnePlastic.
initiative.text: The OnePlastic Lantern is part of the OnePlastic initiative, which turns waste plastic bottles and discarded batteries into light for communities without reliable electricity. Every purchase supports the initiative.

protected.title: Protected design
